summary: The discussion centers on scaling GPU super pods using multiple links and switches, detailing how ECMP routing handles link failures by reducing weights or setting routes to zero, and comparing per-flow versus per-packet load balancing methods for ordered packet delivery. Participants addressed the implementation of memory semantic operations like strong ordering and confirmed that while most scale-up frameworks utilize non-IP encapsulation similar to EVPN for GPU identifiers, some vendors may still support IP-based encapsulation.
